basic_profile.bio: Hailing from the Twin Cities, I'm a die-hard Minnesota Timberwolves fan and a connoisseur of local brews like Hamm's and Grain Belt. On most weekends, you'll find me chilling with friends, debating the latest game stats, or hunting for rare Funko Pop figures. I work as a graphic designer for a small firm and spend my weekday evenings catching up on political memes, hence my frequent visits to PoliticalCompassMeme2. Currently single, I enjoy the freedom to explore my hobbies and engage with Reddit communities. My online hours typically span late evenings, after 8 PM, when I unwind after work.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: My knowledge primarily circles around graphic design, which I studied in college, and sports analytics, a passion I've developed through years of following the Timberwolves. I also have a keen interest in pop culture collectibles, nurtured by years of collecting Funko Pops.
